brief.headline: Push for ₹250/KG on laminates — market research shows that's the fair price and Silk Polypack already gives it to us

priceAsk.summary: Move from ₹385.00/KG to ₹250.00/KG for LAMINATE SKU
priceAsk.target: ₹250.00/KG — our best price today (Silk Polypack) and the typical market ask for pharma sachet laminate
priceAsk.basis: We're paying ₹385.00/KG to UFLEX — 54.0% more than the ₹250.00/KG Silk Polypack charges us for the same material. Market research confirms ₹250/kg sits at the top of the fair band (₹205–305/kg) for pharma/ORS sachet laminate. Closing this gap saves us ₹22718 a year.

paymentTermAsk.summary: Hold at 60 days — their debt is high (1.25× their own cash) so they'd value faster payment, but we're too small (0.00% of their sales) to demand better terms without bundling more volume

brief.financialLeverage: UFLEX is huge — ₹16492.00 Cr in sales — and we're invisible at ₹64788 (0.00% share). They're growing fast (35.5% a year) so they want new orders, but their debt is heavy (1.25× their own cash, ₹10152.31 Cr owed). They keep about ₹4 of every ₹100 they sell (4.1% net margin). Bottom line: on price we have almost no muscle unless we bundle more volume or play them against Huhtamaki or Constantia; on payment terms they'd welcome faster cash but we're too tiny to extract a concession without giving something back.

alternates.why: Listed flexible-packaging converter at ₹2611.64 Cr revenue, health C (59/100) — proven and scalable for laminate sachets

alternates.name: Constantia Parikh Packaging Pvt Ltd
alternates.why: Global Constantia group's India converter (₹222.04 Cr, health D 31/100) — pharma blister and sachet laminates, strong second-source fit

risks: We're 0.00% of their business — they can ignore us unless we bundle more SKUs, commit multi-year volume, or credibly show we'll move tonnage to Huhtamaki or Constantia
Their debt is 1.25× their own cash — low risk to supply continuity today, but monitor; any ratings downgrade or covenant breach could disrupt deliveries
Silk Polypack gives us ₹250/KG today — if UFLEX won't match, simply shift more volume to Silk and qualify Huhtamaki or Constantia as backup
Market ask research shows ₹250/kg is top-of-fair for pharma sachet laminate — pushing much below that (toward ₹205/kg floor) will need a maker's quote or a big volume commitment
brief.suggestedOpeningLine: We're here because we're paying you ₹385/KG for laminates when Silk Polypack gives us the same material at ₹250 — market research backs that ₹250 number, so let's talk about how we close that 54% gap.
